prompt.title: New here?
prompt.text: Take a one-minute tour of this page.

settings.title: Guided tours
settings.description: Short tours that point at where things are. Each page offers its tour once.
settings.done: The tours will be offered again

menu.title: Open the menu
menu.text: Your projects, the characterization tools and plots are in the menu.

projects.title: Your projects
projects.text: Every project you create is listed here. Open one to see its experiments.

newProject.title: Start with a project
newProject.text: A project holds one line of work, such as a paper. Create your first one here.

techniques.title: Characterizations
techniques.text: Analyse raw instrument files (EDX, ellipsometry, FTIR), with or without a project.

plots.title: Plots
plots.text: Plot any table you upload, or an experiment's samples, and save the plot.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Language, appearance, where your files are kept and your AI key.

help.title: Need this again?
help.text: Press here on any page to replay its tour.

tabs.title: Sections
tabs.text: Switch between the project's experiments, its background and its references.

newExperiment.title: Add an experiment
newExperiment.text: An experiment is one kind of sample with its own columns, like one sheet of a spreadsheet.

import.title: Import a spreadsheet
import.text: Bring in samples you already recorded in Excel or a CSV file. Nothing is saved until you confirm the preview.

more.title: More actions
more.text: Edit the project or delete it.

askAi.title: Ask AI
askAi.text: Ask questions about this project's experiments, with your own key.

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.text: Switch between the experiments of this project.

sections.title: Sections
sections.text: Protocol, setup (columns and studies), samples and saved plots.

addSample.title: Add a sample
addSample.text: Record a new sample. Values are prefilled from the previous one.

import.title: Import samples
import.text: Add or update samples from a spreadsheet.

report.title: Report
report.text: A printable summary of this experiment.

export.title: Export
export.text: Download the samples table as Excel or CSV.

more.title: More actions
more.text: Edit the experiment or delete it.

characterizations.title: Characterizations
characterizations.text: Record the measurements done on this sample, such as SEM or EDX, and attach their files.

add.title: Add a characterization
add.text: A technique, a date and a note. Then attach the raw files.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.text: Start a new sample from this one and change only what differs.

report.title: Report
report.text: A printable summary of this sample.
